name: Zollner
description: Long upright rules crossed by short slanting hatches that lean one way and then the other, so the parallels seem to splay.

code.style: --rule: ( @x(odd) { --sk: 40deg; } @x(even) { --sk: -40deg; } @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 45%, #000 45% 55%, transparent 55%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 45%, #000 45% 55%, transparent 55%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 20%; background: @lp(); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8% 25%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 8%, transparent 8% 25%); transform: skewY(@var(--sk)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
